title: WMKGG Ultra Fine Mesh Strainer Bags, Reusable Mesh Filter Bags with Stainless Steel Handle Frame for Filter NutMilk, Coffee, Milk, Butter, Juices and Fresh Cheese (Small Size)
description:
About this item
STURDY, REUSABLE & ECONOMICAL: Made of 100% natural unbleached cotton cloth, sewed together by 80/180 μm mesh food grade cotton wire; perfect mesh size can help the liquid quickly pass through the bag, no more messy residues or pulp stuck in corners.
UPGRADE DESIGN: Reinforced stainless steel frame and sturdy handle, The zipper design that holds the filter is very handy for laying it on mental ring and easy to get out and clean, The filter handle also has a hanging hole for easy storage.the two sides of the bag are sewn with double-track and thread crimping, which is anti-extrusion and does not leak slag.
SUITABLE SIZE: You will get 3 pieces fine mesh strainers and 1 stainless steel frame with handle. the size of the filter bag is approx 8.3 x 9.8 inches, the size of circle frame diameter is approx. 5.6 inches, length of handle is 5.1 inches.After assembly, the small-sized ultra-fine reusable filter has a diameter of 5.6 inches and a depth of 9.8 inches. Please estimate your required dimensions before purchasing for optimal results.
WIDE APPLICATION: The ultra-fine filter allows you to easily filter various beverages, such as milk, coffee, soy milk, fruit juice, rice milk, fruit wine, etc. as well as an indispensable tool for making all kinds of nut milk and beans dairy products.
HANDWASHING: Spread the bag out flat, on it’s side, in the bottom of the sink, and then rise it thoroughly on both sides (top and bottom), then turn it inside out and repeat the process. After rinsing is done, this time scrubbing gently with a soapy sponge. Last, a quick wring out, Takes 50-60 secs, tops.
